identity.promise: Cards begin as one lightly gathered hand, open on a common bottom-centre hinge, settle into a balanced overview, and close through the exact inverse geometry.
identity.antiMotion: The Scene must never become a continuously advancing selection system, an orbit, a random paper swarm, a hover-led z-order fight, or a static pile whose only authored event is generic scale-up.
identity.topology: stable angular slots on one hinge/pivot
identity.focusGrammar: collection remains visible; optional slot spotlight never becomes traversal
identity.finaleGrammar: whole hand remains legible at stable spread

sourcePolicy.identityAndOrder: must survive failure, replacement, reverse and recycling

alphaPolicy: transparent output supported; raw alpha proof quality scored separately
